notes:
- Carousel slides never show you with your eyes closed: every picture is checked and an open-eyed one is chosen.
- When a moment is a screen share with you in a small webcam box, the slide uses another point in the video where you fill the shot.
- Carousel pictures stay sharp: a picture is never blown up, and the sharpest frame of each line is chosen.
- Captions on carousel slides are two lines at most. A longer line is split across two pictures instead.
- Tweet-style slides now show your picture, your name with the blue check lined up beside it, and your @handle under it.
- Click any carousel (or the expand button under it) to see it almost full screen, with arrows either side. Use the arrow keys to move, Esc to close.
